csv_project_name: AE for Cowan Lake State Park Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) Division of Parks and Watercraft operates Cowan Lake State Park. ODNR intends to procure Architectural/Engineering Services for improvements to facilities at Cowan Lake State Park Marina and Beach. Replacement of the three thousand square foot marina retail building, boarding/courtesy/fuel docks and marina seawall are needed as these facilities have reached the end of their useful life. The new marina building should include the following features: retail space, staff support area, storage space, an employee restroom, public restroom facilities accessed from the exterior and consideration for a garage area for boat maintenance. Scope also includes the design of improvements to the beach area including installation of a new shelter and playground. Additionally, this site will include an expansion to existing site parking and drainage improvements to the area.
